sentences.english: I eat an apple every morning.
sentences.chinese: 我每天早上吃一个苹果。

sentences.english: Can you grab a few apples from the fruit bowl?
sentences.chinese: 你能从水果盘里拿几个苹果吗？

sentences.english: My grandma makes the best apple pie, and the whole house smells like cinnamon and baked apples when she's in the kitchen.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶做的苹果派最好吃了，她在厨房忙活的时候，整个房子都飘着肉桂和烤苹果的香味。
sentences.scene: 回忆奶奶做苹果派的温馨时光

sentences.english: The banana is still green.
sentences.chinese: 这根香蕉还是青的。

sentences.english: I like to slice a banana into my cereal in the morning.
sentences.chinese: 我早上喜欢切一根香蕉加到麦片里。

sentences.english: I bought a bunch of bananas two days ago, and they're already covered in brown spots because the weather is so hot.
sentences.chinese: 我两天前买了一串香蕉，因为天气太热，现在上面已经全是褐斑了。
sentences.scene: 抱怨天热导致水果熟得太快

sentences.english: My uncle owns a small farm.
sentences.chinese: 我叔叔有个小农场。
sentences.scene: 向朋友介绍亲戚的职业

sentences.english: We're going to visit a pumpkin farm this weekend.
sentences.chinese: 我们这个周末要去一个南瓜农场玩。

sentences.english: Growing up, I spent every summer on my grandparents' farm, and my favorite thing was collecting warm eggs from the chicken coop.
sentences.chinese: 小时候每个夏天我都在爷爷奶奶的农场度过，我最喜欢的事就是去鸡窝里捡热乎乎的鸡蛋。
sentences.scene: 回忆童年在农场的快乐时光

sentences.english: Let's get some fresh air.
sentences.chinese: 我们出去呼吸点新鲜空气吧。
sentences.scene: 在室内待久了提议出去走走

sentences.english: The air smells like rain. I think a storm is coming.
sentences.chinese: 空气里有雨的味道，我觉得暴风雨要来了。

sentences.english: When I opened the window this morning, the cold air hit my face and I immediately knew I should have worn a warmer jacket.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我一打开窗户，冷空气就扑面而来，我立刻意识到自己应该穿一件更厚的外套。

sentences.english: This orange is really sweet.
sentences.chinese: 这个橙子真甜。

sentences.english: I squeezed three oranges to make a glass of juice.
sentences.chinese: 我榨了三个橙子做了一杯果汁。

sentences.english: My mom always puts an orange in my lunchbox, and I've grown so used to it that lunch feels incomplete without one.
sentences.chinese: 我妈妈总是在我的午餐盒里放一个橙子，我早已习惯成这样，午饭没有橙子就觉得少了点什么。
sentences.scene: 讲述妈妈给带水果的习惯

sentences.english: Please wash the grapes.
sentences.chinese: 请把葡萄洗一下。

sentences.english: I love frozen grapes as a snack on hot summer days.
sentences.chinese: 在炎热的夏天，我喜欢吃冻葡萄当零食。

sentences.english: I brought a bag of grapes to the park for a picnic, but by the time we sat down, they had rolled all over the basket.
sentences.chinese: 我带了一袋葡萄去公园野餐，但等我们坐下时，葡萄已经滚得整个篮子都是。
sentences.scene: 野餐时水果洒出来的小意外

sentences.english: I walk to school every day.
sentences.chinese: 我每天走路上学。

sentences.english: School was canceled yesterday because of the snowstorm.
sentences.chinese: 昨天因为暴风雪学校停课了。

sentences.english: I still remember my first day of school: I was so nervous I held my dad's hand and wouldn't let go until I saw a friendly teacher at the door.
sentences.chinese: 我还记得第一天上学的场景：我紧张得一直拉着爸爸的手不放，直到在校门口看到一位和蔼的老师。
sentences.scene: 回忆第一天上学时的紧张心情

sentences.english: My mom loves her flower garden.
sentences.chinese: 我妈妈很喜欢她的花园。

sentences.english: We planted tomatoes and cucumbers in the garden this year.
sentences.chinese: 今年我们在菜园里种了西红柿和黄瓜。
sentences.scene: 分享自家菜园的种植情况

sentences.english: After a long day at work, I love sitting in the garden with a cup of tea, just listening to the birds and watching the sun go down.
sentences.chinese: 工作了一天之后，我喜欢坐在花园里喝杯茶，听听鸟叫，看看日落。
sentences.scene: 花园是下班后的宁静角落

sentences.english: I need a glass of water.
sentences.chinese: 我需要一杯水。

sentences.english: We need to leave by seven if we want to make the movie.
sentences.chinese: 如果想赶上那部电影，我们得七点前出发。

sentences.english: I need to buy some new running shoes because my old ones are so worn out that my feet hurt after every run.
sentences.chinese: 我需要买双新跑鞋，因为旧的那双已经磨得不行了，每次跑完脚都疼。

sentences.english: Can I have some water?
sentences.chinese: 能给我点水吗？
sentences.scene: 在朋友家或餐厅要水喝

sentences.english: Don't forget to water the plants before you leave.
sentences.chinese: 你走之前别忘了给植物浇水。

sentences.english: I was so thirsty after the hike that I drank a whole bottle of water in seconds, and it was the most refreshing thing I've ever tasted.
sentences.chinese: 徒步之后我渴坏了，几秒钟就灌下了一整瓶水，那真是我喝过最解渴的东西。

sentences.english: These flowers smell wonderful.
sentences.chinese: 这些花闻起来好香。

sentences.english: He brought me flowers for no reason, just to cheer me up.
sentences.chinese: 他无缘无故给我带了花，就是为了让我开心。

sentences.english: I tried to grow roses last year, but the flowers never bloomed; turns out I wasn't giving them enough sun.
sentences.chinese: 去年我试着种玫瑰，但花一直没开；后来才知道是阳光不够。

sentences.english: The grass is wet in the morning.
sentences.chinese: 早上的草地是湿的。
sentences.scene: 早晨走到草坪上的发现

sentences.english: Let's sit on the grass and eat our sandwiches.
sentences.chinese: 我们坐在草地上吃三明治吧。

sentences.english: My dad asked me to mow the lawn, but the grass was so tall that the mower kept getting stuck.
sentences.chinese: 我爸让我修剪草坪，但草长得太高了，割草机老是卡住。
sentences.scene: 周末做家务时遇到的麻烦

sentences.english: This plant needs more sunlight.
sentences.chinese: 这株植物需要更多阳光。
sentences.scene: 观察室内盆栽后得出的结论

sentences.english: We're going to plant some tulip bulbs this autumn.
sentences.chinese: 今年秋天我们打算种些郁金香球茎。

sentences.english: I bought a tiny plant from the farmers' market, and now, two years later, it's grown so big I had to move it to a bigger pot.
sentences.chinese: 我在农夫市场买了一株小小的植物，现在两年过去了，它长得太大，我只好给它换了个更大的花盆。
sentences.scene: 看着植物慢慢长大的成就感

sentences.english: I got a new phone today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天买了个新手机。

sentences.english: There's a new coffee shop on the corner. Want to try it?
sentences.chinese: 街角新开了一家咖啡店，想去试试吗？

sentences.english: Starting a new school is always scary at first, but I'm sure you'll make friends in no time.
sentences.chinese: 刚到一个新学校总是挺吓人的，但我相信你很快就能交到朋友。
sentences.scene: 安慰转学的朋友或孩子

sentences.english: A bird is sitting on that tree.
sentences.chinese: 有只鸟停在树上。

sentences.english: We hung a swing from the big tree in the backyard.
sentences.chinese: 我们在后院的大树上挂了个秋千。
sentences.scene: 为家里增添一个玩耍设施

sentences.english: During the storm, a huge branch fell off the old oak tree in front of our house, and we were without power for two days.
sentences.chinese: 暴风雨中，我们家门前那棵老橡树的一根大树杈掉了下来，害得我们停电了两天。

sentences.english: The sun is so bright today!
sentences.chinese: 今天太阳好刺眼！

sentences.english: We spent the whole afternoon lying in the sun at the beach.
sentences.chinese: 我们整个下午都在沙滩上晒太阳。

sentences.english: I forgot to put on sunscreen, and after an hour in the sun, my shoulders were red and stinging.
sentences.chinese: 我忘了涂防晒霜，在太阳底下晒了一个小时，肩膀就又红又疼。

sentences.english: Can you give me a pen?
sentences.chinese: 能给我一支笔吗？
sentences.scene: 在教室或办公室借文具

sentences.english: I want to give my mom something special for her birthday.
sentences.chinese: 我想给我妈妈送一份特别的生日礼物。

sentences.english: My grandpa gave me this old watch when I graduated, and even though it's not expensive, it means the world to me.
sentences.chinese: 我毕业时爷爷给了我这块旧手表，它虽然不贵，但对我来说意义非凡。

sentences.english: I don't like them.
sentences.chinese: 我不喜欢它们。
sentences.scene: 表达对某物或某事的排斥

sentences.english: I bought some cookies. Do you want to try them?
sentences.chinese: 我买了些饼干，你想尝尝吗？

sentences.english: I ran into my old neighbors at the store, and I was so happy to see them that we stood in the aisle talking for half an hour.
sentences.chinese: 我在商店里碰见了老邻居，太高兴了，我们在过道上站着聊了半个小时。
